rows.content: What has been mentioned (all utterances) vs. what has been saved (curated durable facts/preferences).

When a user asks if they've "mentioned" something, it's important to clarify that "mentioned" ≠ "saved." Telling me something doesn't guarantee it was stored unless it crosses the threshold of worth keeping (e.g., durable facts or preferences). Additionally, room isolation means I can only definitively report what's in accessible rooms; absence of evidence in one room doesn't prove it wasn't mentioned elsewhere. This distinction matters for how I frame answers to "have I ever said X?"
